feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: The significance of Colom's win in Mississippi
entry.summary:
Scott Colom <<coh-loam>> will be Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction.
That era was about 150 years ago.</coh-loam>

entry.title: People getting hot and bothered over newly-elected Democratic men
entry.summary: You may have noticed that a lot of people on social media are getting really hot and bothered over the newly-elected Democratic men. It says a lot about how Democrats have responded to the Trump era.

entry.title: Colorado flood victims hope for speedier federal help
entry.summary: Local and state officials in Colorado say recent floods have outstripped their ability to respond. They're worried about federal response after Trump delayed flood aid for political reasons in 2025.

entry.title: Chicagoan-born Pope Leo returns to his second home Peru
entry.summary: This is a homecoming for Pope Leo who spent decades in the South American country before being called to Rome in 2023. He is a naturalized Peruvian citizen and often speaks Spanish with his followers.

entry.title: Israeli air strike on Gaza hospital kills six, including surgeon
entry.summary: Israeli launches its first air strike on a Gaza hospital since the ceasefire began last year.

entry.title: This week in science: PTSD prediction, phishing while tired, an exoplanet
entry.summary: The regular news roundup with NPR's science podcast Short Wave covers a possible use for AI in emergency rooms, a distant planet and the link between cybersecurity and Daylight Saving Time.

entry.title: Launch-ready, the Space Shuttle Endeavour goes back on display
entry.summary: The Space Shuttle Endeavour has been on display in California since 2012 — not long after NASA ended the program. Now, the California Science Center is showing off the shuttle in a new way.

entry.title: Search and rescue at site of collapsed New York City apartment building
entry.summary: First responders are still searching through the rubble of a three story apartment building that collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday, looking for any possible survivors.

entry.title: In 'The Good Daughter,' hard realities are met with some humor
entry.summary: nov 12 peacockNPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Karin Slaughter and Rose Byrne about their new TV series, The Good Daughter.

entry.title: What we know so far about Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress
entry.summary: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress has served as the company's chief financial officers. Kevin Roose, host of NPR's Machine Gods podcast, talks with Scott Detrow about what to expect from her.
